title: ALINA v1 release candidate hardening
goal: Collect real runtime quality evidence, harden runtime configuration/failure boundaries and compute a truthful frontend release-candidate status.
why: M1.7 hard gates passed but release readiness remained conditional because runtime metrics were unknown.
constraints: live mode must never silently fall back to DEMO
runtime measurements must record browser/environment provenance
renderer failures must not crash product state
acceptanceCriteria: LCP/CLS/interaction responsiveness/long-task/frame-time are measured or explicitly unresolved
live config without API is unavailable, never demo
runtime quality report contains environment provenance
release status is computed from evidence
fatal render failure has user-visible boundary
CI uploads runtime and release reports
